note: Draft readout lessons, round 1 (2026-09-26). mark: 0-based line indexes turned amber. master: Wang Bi's own phrase naming the line the hexagram's master (series/wangbi.json), shown with English. finding: one line from the structure or the Tuan. text: the sentence typed last, at most 18 characters a line.

drafts.finding: SIX STRONG LINES. NO REST.
drafts.text:
Heaven never
takes a day off.
drafts.source: image

drafts.finding: SIX YIELDING LINES. ALL FOLLOW.
drafts.source: judgment: at first disoriented, then finding the way

drafts.finding: MOVEMENT UNDER DANGER.
drafts.text:
Sort the threads
before you pull.
drafts.source: image: sorts the threads; judgment: do not venture

drafts.finding: THE YOUTH (5) SEEKS THE TEACHER (2).
drafts.source: judgment

drafts.finding: HEAVEN RISES. WATER SINKS. APART.
drafts.text:
Take it to
a fair judge.
drafts.source: judgment: meeting the great person; Wang Bi L5 judges crooked and straight

drafts.finding: ONE YIELDING LINE HOLDS FIVE.
drafts.text:
Small can hold
big, for a while.
drafts.source: Tuan 柔得位而上下應之; judgment: dense clouds, no rain

drafts.finding: A SOFT LINE TREADS ON THE STRONG.
drafts.text:
Tread softly
and it won't bite.
drafts.source: judgment; Wang Bi on the Tuan: soft treads on firm, answering Qian with joy

drafts.finding: LINE 2 MEETS LINE 5 IN THE OPEN.
drafts.text:
Meet in the open,
not in a clique.
drafts.source: judgment: fellowship in the open; line 2 fellowship in the clan

drafts.finding: ONE STRONG LINE. FIVE FOLLOW IT.
drafts.text:
One clear voice
moves the crowd.
drafts.source: Wang Bi L4, L5; image: music

drafts.finding: THE STRONG GOES BELOW THE WEAK.
drafts.source: Wang Bi on the judgment: the firm places itself below the yielding

drafts.finding: TWO STRONG LINES ON TOP. ALL LOOK UP.
drafts.source: judgment: hands washed, offering not yet made

drafts.finding: THE SOFT COMES TO ADORN THE STRONG.
drafts.source: Tuan 柔來而文剛; image: does not decide disputes this way

drafts.finding: A STRONG LINE COMES IN AT THE BASE.
drafts.source: Wang Bi on the Tuan: the firm comes from without and rules within

drafts.finding: THE MOUNTAIN HOLDS HEAVEN IN.
drafts.text:
Store up strength,
then use it.
drafts.source: image; judgment: crossing the great river

drafts.finding: ALL THREE PAIRS ANSWER.
drafts.source: image: receives others through emptiness

drafts.finding: TWO YIELDING LINES CREEP UP.
drafts.source: image: distance with dignity

drafts.finding: FOUR STRONG LINES PUSH UP.
drafts.source: image: does not tread where improper

drafts.finding: THE SOFT RISES TO THE TOP CENTRE.
drafts.source: Wang Bi: the soft advances upward; image: brightens own character

drafts.finding: FIVE LINES IN THEIR PLACE.
drafts.text:
Mean what
you say at home.
drafts.source: image: speaks with substance, acts with consistency

drafts.finding: FIVE OUT OF PLACE. TWO PAIRS ANSWER.
drafts.source: judgment: small matters; image: commonality, difference

drafts.finding: FIVE IN PLACE. STILL BLOCKED.
drafts.source: Wang Bi: the lines all occupy their positions; image: turns inward

drafts.finding: THUNDER BREAKS OUT OF THE WATER.
drafts.source: judgment: act promptly; image: pardons

drafts.finding: THE LOW LINE GIVES TO THE TOP.
drafts.source: judgment; Wang Bi: decrease the lower to benefit the upper

drafts.finding: FOUR YIELDING LINES GATHER TO TWO.
drafts.source: image: guards against the unexpected

drafts.finding: WOOD UNDER EARTH, GROWING UP.
drafts.source: judgment: see the great person

drafts.finding: FIRE IN THE LAKE. ONE MUST GIVE.
drafts.text:
For a revolution,
a new calendar.
drafts.source: image

drafts.finding: NO PAIR ANSWERS. EACH STANDS STILL.
drafts.source: image: thinks of nothing beyond the present situation

drafts.finding: LINES 2 TO 5 IN PLACE, STEP BY STEP.
drafts.text:
Grow like a tree
on a mountain.
drafts.source: image

drafts.finding: LINES 2 TO 5 ALL OUT OF PLACE.
drafts.source: judgment: advancing adverse

drafts.finding: THUNDER AND FIRE AT ONCE: FULL.
drafts.source: judgment: the sun at midday; Tuan 日中則昃

drafts.finding: WIND ON WIND. NO PAIR ANSWERS.
drafts.source: image: reiterates commands

drafts.finding: WIND MOVES OVER WATER.
drafts.text:
Bring them back
to the centre.
drafts.source: judgment: the king approaches the temple

drafts.finding: THE STRONG HOLDS THE CENTRE.
drafts.text:
A lake holds only
so much water.
drafts.source: image

drafts.finding: ALL SIX OUT OF PLACE. ALL ANSWER.
drafts.text:
Almost across,
the fox gets wet.
drafts.source: judgment
